name: RecallMate 简洁界面方案 v1
purpose: 三张设计预览，未修改应用界面或发布程序

screens.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high fidelity desktop UI design proposal, screen 1 of a cohesive three-screen set for RecallMate, a Chinese offline fill-in-the-blank study application.
Create a crisp straight-on full desktop application screenshot, landscape 16:10, high resolution, flat functional UI. The user wants a substantially simpler, quieter interface, with all slogans and promotional decorations removed. This is a NEW design, not an edit. Do not modify code. This is a design preview.
Shared design system for all screens: white and very pale neutral grey surfaces (#F7F8FA), dark charcoal readable text (#25332E), a restrained muted forest green accent (#28755D) only for selected navigation and primary actions, subtle 1px separators, 5px small corner radii. Chinese sans serif like Microsoft YaHei UI / Source Han Sans, highly legible Chinese lettering, restrained font sizes and regular weights. No shadows, no gradients, no illustrations, no motivational copy, no avatar, no metric cards, no left sidebar.
Composition: one compact 52px top navigation bar, then a working content area with 32px horizontal margins. Top bar left: a tiny simple green leaf outline icon and "RecallMate" in semibold, then two compact navigation tabs "题库" (selected, thin green underline) and "错题"; far right one small settings gear labelled "设置". This is the sole global header. No extra breadcrumb header or large page masthead.
Home screen:
At 30px beneath top bar one slim toolbar: left search field with search icon and exact placeholder "搜索题库"; beside it small muted text "3 个题库 · 208 道题"; right one green button "+ 导入题库".
Below toolbar, a clean full-width table, NOT cards, NOT a dashboard. Header labels exactly "题库名称", "题目", "错题", "最近练习", "操作". Thin horizontal rules only; no vertical gridlines. Three generously readable 68px rows:
Row 1: small document outline icon then "保密管理知识"; columns "128", "16", "今天 10:32"; one modest green outlined button "继续练习", one subdued text link "管理", small horizontal ellipsis menu.
Row 2: small document icon then "综合知识"; "20", "3", "昨天 21:10"; outlined button "开始练习", text "管理", ellipsis.
Row 3: small document icon then "英语词汇"; "60", "8", "尚未练习"; outlined button "开始练习", text "管理", ellipsis.
Useful data is visually aligned; title rows are dark readable, secondary metadata muted but legible. Large lower area intentionally calm and empty, no filler graphics or additional panels.
Bottom right of window: tiny quiet green check with exact text "已保存", not a large status header.
Requirements: render Chinese verbatim; screenshot-ready, professional compact utility software, not a marketing landing page. No English slogans. No phrase YOUR PERSONAL MEMORY GARDEN. No promotional sentences. No sidebar. No motivational notes. No student avatar. No huge whitespace above useful content. No extra invented panels or functions. Entire window visible, no photograph, no perspective, no laptop frame, no surrounding presentation board.

Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: RecallMate compact UI design set, screen 2 — question bank details.
Input image: the supplied RecallMate home mockup is the EDIT TARGET and shell/style reference. Derive a second screen by changing only the working content below the navigation bar. Preserve the exact window proportions, native titlebar, RecallMate wordmark, compact horizontal navigation, forest green accent, pale neutral background, Chinese sans-serif type and subtle separators from the reference.
Primary request: a simpler functional Chinese offline study application's bank management screen. No slogans, no promotional text, no illustrations, no avatars, no sidebar, no dashboard cards. High fidelity flat desktop screenshot, entire window visible.
Keep top navigation exactly: tiny leaf icon, "RecallMate", "题库" selected, "错题", right gear "设置". Keep a small bottom-right "已保存" status.
Working area layout, content starts near top with 32px padding, no giant masthead:
A single compact bank toolbar: left an arrow back icon followed by the readable bank name "综合知识", a small muted inline count "20 道题 · 3 道错题". On the right a subtle outlined "导出备份" button, then a green "开始练习" button with a small dropdown chevron (for sequential/random). Bank title is 20px, not a marketing headline.
Below, compact tabs "全部题目 20" (selected with thin green underline) and "错题本 3".
One slim list toolbar below tabs: search field on the left, exact placeholder "搜索题干或答案"; right a subdued "+ 新增题目" text button.
A single clean full-width table with thin horizontal rules only, header labels "题号", "题目", "填空", "操作".
Six readable 62px rows. Numbers are muted and text dark. Replace answer positions with plain short underscore blanks; never show the correct answers here.
Row 01: "光合作用主要发生在植物细胞的 ______ 中。" | "1" | play outline icon, pencil outline icon, ellipsis.
Row 02: "水的化学式是 ______ 。" | "1" | same action icons.
Row 03: "细胞的遗传信息主要储存在 ______ 中。" | "1" | same icons.
Row 04: "人体血液中负责运输氧气的蛋白质是 ______ 。" | "1" | same icons.
Row 05: "细胞呼吸包括 ______ 、 ______ 和 ______ 。" | "3" | same icons.
Row 06: "在标准大气压下，水的沸点是 ______ 摄氏度。" | "1" | same icons.
One small muted ochre "错题" text tag beside question 03, no red blocks.
Below table small pagination "共 20 题" on left and "‹  1  2  3  4  ›" on right, with selected 1 quietly green.
Leave remaining lower space clear. Good scanability, minimal chrome, no extra description paragraphs. All Chinese must be accurate and crisp. No large repeated text "题库详情", no repeated bank title elsewhere. Do not add features or any English slogans. Preserve reference styling closely.

Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: RecallMate compact UI design set, screen 3 — focused fill-in-the-blank practice.
Input image: supplied RecallMate bank-details mockup is the EDIT TARGET and exact visual shell/style reference. Change ONLY the working area below the shared top navigation into a focused practice screen. Preserve window aspect ratio, compact native titlebar, RecallMate leaf wordmark, top horizontal navigation and right settings, type family, exact neutral background and muted green accent. High fidelity readable Chinese desktop screenshot, full window, no perspective.
Design intent: practical, minimal, coherent with the supplied mockup. Remove absolutely all motivational and decorative text. No giant slogan header, no banners, no sidebar, no illustrations, no avatars, no metric cards, no separated little help tiles. The question is the visual priority.
Keep global navigation: tiny leaf icon "RecallMate", "题库", "错题", right gear "设置". Same compact 52px top bar.
Content area:
At top, ONE slim horizontal practice toolbar: back arrow with "退出练习" on left; bank name "综合知识" with a small muted inline "顺序练习" nearby; far right exact progress "5 / 20". Beneath toolbar one very thin green progress line at 25%, the rest pale grey. No other repeated headings or bank titles.
A calm wide WHITE central work area, not floating nested cards. Generous but not excessive margins, subtle horizontal separators only. The actual task should start in the upper-middle, not buried under introductory material.
Small muted functional label above the question: "第 5 题 · 3 个填空".
Large, clear 25px-equivalent Chinese sentence with three inline answer fields, normal left-to-right text:
"细胞呼吸包括" then an inline completed field containing "糖酵解" with a tiny green check and pale green underline; punctuation "、"; a second field containing the user partial answer "三羧酸" and a text caret, active green outline; then "和"; a third empty field displaying a very faint "03"; end punctuation "。".
The three inline inputs are generous enough for typing, approximately 130px / 210px / 180px at logical desktop scale. All align elegantly on the sentence baseline. The sentence may wrap naturally once if necessary but must remain grammatically and visually connected. Color is reserved for green correct/focused state; no decorative colored boxes.
Below the active second input only a tiny practical label "第 2 空", optionally on a quiet caption row. Below the question, a single small muted functional instruction "按 Enter 确认当前答案". No motivational wording anywhere.
At the bottom of the work area a SINGLE horizontal action bar, anchored above the small global bottom status:
Left group of flat icon-and-text buttons, no card outlines and no second-line descriptions: eye icon "答案（按住）", bulb icon "提示", flag icon "放弃".
A very subtle vertical divider, then muted text button "跳过".
Far right one green primary button "确认答案" with a small Enter arrow key glyph.
Same tiny bottom-right check status "已保存" as other screens.
Use natural desktop whitespace; useful content, answer inputs, and all controls fully visible simultaneously. Visually concise, accessible contrast, precise Chinese text. Avoid extra text, no English slogans, no QUESTION label, no feedback confetti, no learn-growth sentences, no duplicates, no feature additions. Keep all shared chrome identical to the reference image.
